conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I want to withdraw my fixed deposit early. How does that work?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I can assist with that Sir. Can you provide your FD account number?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s eight four, two four, six one, one three, five nine. Will I lose all the interest?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: For premature withdrawal, you’ll get a reduced interest rate. I can calculate the exact amount if you’d like.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Please do. I need the money soon, so make it quick.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: The FD is worth ₹5,00,000 with ₹15,000 interest after penalty. I’ve initiated the withdrawal.
